info.name: MicroLending - UC01-UC04 loan life cycle
info.description:
REST API of the MicroLending demo backend (Spring Boot + Camunda 8).

How to use:
1. Start Docker (camunda-local), the backend (port 8898).
2. Run a folder top to bottom. Register / quick-start requests save {{applicationId}};
   task requests find their own {{jobKey}}.
3. Watch the process in Operate (http://localhost:8081) and the customer screens at http://localhost:3077.

Demo triggers: see backend docs/DEMO-TRIGGERS.md (e.g. ID number ending 000 = identity failure, last name Fraud = fraud alert).
